description: This Java source file defines the EntityArtifactInfo class, which represents metadata and related information about an entity in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to retrieve related entities, services, ECA rules, forms, and screens associated with a specific entity.

classes.name: EntityArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents detailed information about an entity, including relationships, services, and associated UI components in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates related entities (one-to-one and many-to-many) for this entity.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the underlying ModelEntity object representing the entity metadata.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name, which is the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the type of artifact, here 'Entity'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type ID of this artifact info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this entity artifact, typically the entity name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL location of the entity definition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the entity's name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on toString() output.

methods.name: getEntitiesRelatedOne
methods.description: Returns a set of related entities with a one-to-one relation.

methods.name: getEntitiesRelatedMany
methods.description: Returns a set of related entities with a many-to-many relation.

methods.name: getServicesUsingEntity
methods.description: Returns services that use this entity.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByEntityEca
methods.description: Returns services invoked by the entity's ECA rules (not yet implemented).

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Returns ECA rules associated with the entity (not yet implemented).

methods.name: getFormsUsingEntity
methods.description: Returns UI form definitions that refer to this entity.

methods.name: getScreensUsingEntity
methods.description: Returns UI screen definitions that refer to this entity.
